title: Spatial Reality DNA v9B.1
description: Masterpiece OS Space Generator Phase 9B.1 Spatial Reality Calibration Input. v9B.1 是 Phase 9B Spatial Intent Reasoning 的 Reality Constraint layer, 输入 spatialRealityDna (8 字段) 编译为 spatial_reality_constraint block, 防止 Spatial Intent 增强后模型偏向 exhibition/installation/concept architecture, 提升商业真实性. 不调真实 Provider, 不修改 Prompt Runtime (Phase 9B.1 §8 验收). 冻结 Spatial Intent / Architecture Anchor / architecture_context (Phase 9B.1 §8).

spaceType.description: Phase 9B.1 §3 字段 1: 空间类型 (e.g. 'medical_aesthetics_clinic' / 'casual_restaurant' / 'tcm_wellness_clinic')

commercialScale.description: Phase 9B.1 §3 字段 2: 商业规模 (e.g. '200 sqm flagship clinic' / '80-150 sqm casual dining')

requiredZones.description: Phase 9B.1 §3 字段 3: 必备功能区 (e.g. ['reception', 'waiting', 'consultation', 'treatment'])

operationLogic.description: Phase 9B.1 §3 字段 4: 运营逻辑 (e.g. 'patient flow + VIP appointment' / 'visible food prep + social dining')

userFlow.description: Phase 9B.1 §3 字段 5: 用户动线 (e.g. 'street -> reception -> waiting -> consultation -> treatment')

privacyRequirement.description: Phase 9B.1 §3 字段 6: 隐私要求 (e.g. 'open public + filtered semi-private + enclosed treatment')

materialReality.description: Phase 9B.1 §3 字段 7: 材料现实 (e.g. 'real medical-grade materials: mineral_plaster, frosted_glass, brushed metal')

forbiddenSpatialTypes.description: Phase 9B.1 §3 字段 8: 反漂移 (e.g. ['hospital corridor', 'art gallery', 'nightclub', 'exhibition hall'])

metadata.description: frozen metadata: frozenAt / frozenBy / sourceArchitectureAnchors / notes

constrain 商业真实性, 防止模型偏向 exhibition / installation / concept architecture
提供 必备功能区 + 用户动线 + 反漂移 forbidden spatial types
